verdict.rationale: Brevo's pricing page lists a built-in AI capability to "Draft subject lines and email copy, adjust tone, and more," which directly covers the core of the story. The evidence is a single marketing line, so it is unclear whether this works inside the email composer or generates from a brief. missing for 10: confirmation that the AI runs inside the email composer, documentation of drafting from a brief or prompt, refinement workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer

citations.quote: Draft subject lines and email copy, adjust tone, and more.
